DIAGNOSIS
STEP 1. Check the power window main switch continuity.
(1) Remove the power window main switch. (Refer to P.42-71.)
(2) Check the continuity when the power window main switch 
<RH> is turned to the UP position or DOWN position.
Q: Is the power window main switch damaged?
YES : Replace it, then go to Step 6.
NO : Go to Step 2.
STEP 2. Check the power window sub-switch continuity.
(1) Remove the power window sub-switch. (Refer to P.42-71.)
(2) Check the continuity when the power window sub-switch is 
turned to the UP position or DOWN position.
Q: Is the power window sub-switch damaged?
YES : Replace it, then go to Step 6.
NO : Go to Step 3.
